title: Enterprise capability
headline: People are the advantage.
decision: Authorize a bounded test on a scientific and a digital or commercial mission.
success: Compare delivery, quality and capability growth on two real missions.
guard: No restructuring, headcount target or new platform commitment.

title: Future capabilities
headline: Tools change. Judgment must endure.
decision: Use critical-task profiles in the selected missions.
success: Measure successful independent task completion, quality and time to competence.
guard: Qualifications, human review and regulated controls remain mandatory.

title: Talent allocation
headline: Fill the capability gap, not the vacancy.
decision: Require a capability check before selected requisitions.
success: Track qualified mission coverage, time to contribution and backfill risk.
guard: Do not move capacity out of critical work or count unqualified employees.

title: Hiring excellence
headline: Hire on evidence, not impressions.
decision: Trial a common rubric in selected role families.
success: Check assessor agreement, fairness, quality of hire and time to contribution.
guard: Mandatory qualifications and accessible, locally lawful assessments are non-negotiable.

title: Adaptive problem-solving
headline: Hire for what happens when the answer changes.
decision: Test short, role-specific assessments before using them in selection.
success: Calibrate assessors on anchored observations; compare subsequent job performance and fairness.
guard: No production work, forced choices or unsupported predictive scores.

title: Growth and mobility
headline: Training is an activity. Capability is an outcome.
decision: Connect learning records to approved capability opportunities in the test.
success: Track validated work products, internal moves, time to independence and retention.
guard: Protect learning time, qualification standards and fair access to mobility.

title: Team effectiveness
headline: Build the team for the mission.
decision: Use readiness and capability growth together when allocating talent.
success: Check delivery, quality, qualification and protected development time.
guard: No forced ranking, arbitrary team size or trade-off against safety.

title: Coordination and reuse
headline: See the work before starting more.
decision: Add a discover-before-build check to existing work intake.
success: Measure actual coordination time, reuse and decision lead time. Keep required quality reviews.
guard: Retain quality reviews, local requirements and direct dependency conversations.

title: Partner ownership
headline: Define what good looks like before delivery.
decision: Agree acceptance criteria and knowledge-transfer requirements before strategic work starts.
success: Track first-pass acceptance, rework cost, quality and internal maintainability.
guard: Do not insource commodity services or extend manufacturing rules beyond their scope.

title: Evidence-led implementation
headline: Prove value before scaling.
decision: Use common evidence gates in existing portfolio processes.
success: Scale only when the agreed outcome improves and quality, fairness and feasibility hold.
guard: Safety, privacy, employee consultation and independent quality review cannot be bypassed.

title: Enterprise decision
headline: Every mission should make Takeda stronger.
decision: Authorize two bounded missions using existing systems and a common evidence standard.
success: Track delivery, quality, capability growth and retained knowledge. Scale only what works.
guard: No universal policy, technology platform or predetermined savings target.
